notes.title: Zodiac Mountain Teaser
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, Travelers![/p][p]We’re thrilled to unveil the [b]official gameplay trailer[/b] for [b]Zodiac Mountain[/b]—our upcoming roguelike deckbuilder inspired by Chinese mythology, elemental combat, and the pursuit of worth.[/p][p]🌄 In this new trailer, witness:[/p][list][*][p]The young Panda’s first steps at the gates of Zodiac Mountain[/p][/*][*][p]A glimpse into shrines, blessings, shops, and upgrades that shape your journey[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic battles using the dual forces of [b]Yin & Yang[/b], facing off against mythical foes and the mighty Chinese Zodiacs[/p][/*][/list][p]🔥 As the Panda ascends, he doesn’t just grow stronger—he strives to become worthy of the legends that came before him.[/p][p]🎥 [b]Watch the trailer now[/b] and wishlist Zodiac Mountain if you haven’t already:[/p][previewyoutube="-JXHhrE86-4;full"][/previewyoutube][p]🗓️ Our game demo will playable during Eastern Martial Arts Week (June 19th-25th), and you can look forward to more exciting updates as we approach our Steam Next Fest debut![/p][p]Your support means the world to us—thank you for walking this path with us.[/p][p]
🧭 Follow us on [url="https://www.instagram.com/mysticroadgames/"]Instagram[/url], and stay up to date through our [url="https://discord.gg/H9cjEqRGvc"]Discord[/url][/p]
